
---
title: "Penguin Data Analysis"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

## Penguin Dataset Overview

This dataset contains information about penguins from three different species.

```{r}
penguins %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarize(
    avg_bill_length = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    count = n()
  )
```

## Penguin Bill Length Plot

```{r}
ggplot(penguins, aes(x = species, y = bill_length_mm, fill = species)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Penguin Bill Length by Species",
    x = "Species",
    y = "Bill Length (mm)"
  )
```
